lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Adding wait-time information on the home screen was helpful across 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 9, and 10), while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, sign-in notifications, choose-path copy, and finish new-flow flows consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.

Evidence remains thin or mixed for categories like adoption copy, adoption redesign, adoption new-flow, choose-path layout, choose-path new-flow, finish hint, finish redesign, and home redesign, where at most 1 test won while others showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions consistently overestimated non-winning tests, predicting positive lifts for changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests, predicting modest or negative gains for changes that produced large wins.
